name: Genesis
summary: The book of origins: creation, the fall, the global flood, and the covenant journey of the Patriarchs from Ur to Canaan and into Egypt.

milestones.name: Garden of Eden & Mesopotamia
milestones.narrative: Creation of man and dawn of redemptive history in the fertile crescent.

milestones.name: Mount Ararat
milestones.narrative: Resting place of Noah's Ark after the great deluge; rainbow covenant.

milestones.name: Ur of the Chaldees
milestones.narrative: Birthplace of Abram; departure by faith into the unknown.

milestones.name: Shechem & Bethel
milestones.narrative: First altar built in Canaan; Jacob's ladder vision of the angels of God.

milestones.name: Hebron (Cave of Machpelah)
milestones.narrative: Patriarchal burial site purchased by Abraham for Sarah and descendants.

milestones.name: Land of Goshen (Egypt)
milestones.narrative: Joseph's ascension as viceroy of Egypt and preservation of Israel during famine.

name: Exodus
region: Nile Delta, Red Sea & Mount Sinai
summary: Deliverance of Israel from Egyptian bondage, miraculous Red Sea crossing, giving of the Law at Mount Sinai, and erection of the Tabernacle.

milestones.name: Rameses / Goshen
milestones.narrative: Ten plagues poured upon Egypt; first Passover lamb slain.

milestones.name: Red Sea Crossing (Gulf of Suez)
milestones.narrative: Waters parted by the east wind; Egyptian army vanquished.

milestones.name: Marah & Elim
milestones.narrative: Bitter waters sweetened; 12 springs and 70 palm trees of oasis.

milestones.name: Rephidim
milestones.narrative: Water from the struck rock of Horeb; Aaron and Hur uphold Moses' hands.

milestones.name: Mount Sinai (Jebel Musa)
milestones.narrative: The Ten Commandments delivered in thunder, fire, and smoke; Tabernacle pattern revealed.

name: Leviticus
summary: The holy protocol of sacrifice, priesthood consecration, purity, and the annual Day of Atonement given at the base of Mount Sinai.

milestones.name: The Tabernacle Courtyard (Sinai)
milestones.narrative: Burnt, grain, peace, sin, and trespass offerings instituted for holy communion.

milestones.name: Holy of Holies (The Mercy Seat)
milestones.narrative: The High Priest enters once a year with sacrificial blood on Yom Kippur.

name: Numbers
summary: Census of the tribes, spy reconnaissance from Kadesh-Barnea, 40-year wilderness wanderings, and journey to the threshold of Canaan.

milestones.name: Wilderness of Paran
milestones.narrative: Departure from Sinai guided by the pillar of cloud by day and fire by night.

milestones.name: Kadesh Barnea
milestones.narrative: Twelve spies sent into Canaan; ten bring an evil report; 40-year wandering decreed.

milestones.name: Mount Hor (Edom)
milestones.narrative: Death and burial of Aaron; high priesthood transferred to Eleazar.

milestones.name: Plains of Moab (Opposite Jericho)
milestones.narrative: Bronze serpent lifted up on the pole; Balaam's prophetic blessings over Israel.

name: Deuteronomy
summary: Moses' final covenant discourses to the second generation on the east bank of the Jordan, concluding with Moses' view from Mount Nebo.

milestones.name: Plains of Moab
milestones.narrative: Recitation of the Shema: Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord.

milestones.name: Mount Nebo (Pisgah)
milestones.narrative: God shows Moses the entire Promised Land; Moses dies in the presence of the Lord.

name: Joshua
summary: Jordan river dry crossing, fall of Jericho, southern and northern conquest campaigns, and allotment of tribal inheritances in Canaan.

milestones.name: Gilgal
milestones.narrative: Memorial stones set up from the parted Jordan River; circumcision renewed.

milestones.name: Jericho
milestones.narrative: Walls fall flat after seven days of marching and trumpet blasts; Rahab spared.

milestones.name: Valley of Aijalon
milestones.narrative: Sun and moon stand still as Joshua defeats the Amorite confederacy.

milestones.name: Hazor
milestones.narrative: Jabin's northern coalition shattered; chariot horses hamstrung; city burned.

milestones.name: Shechem
milestones.narrative: Joshua's farewell charge: As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord.

name: Judges
region: All Canaan: Mount Tabor, Jezreel, Timnah & Gaza
summary: Israel's cycles of idolatry, enemy oppression, repentance, and military deliverance through 12 charismatic judges.

milestones.name: Mount Tabor & Kishon River
milestones.narrative: Deborah and Barak rout Sisera's 900 iron chariots.

milestones.name: Spring of Harod (Jezreel)
milestones.narrative: Gideon tests 300 men with water lap; Midianite camp panicked by torches in jars.

milestones.name: Lehi & Sorek Valley
milestones.narrative: Samson slays 1,000 Philistines with a donkey's jawbone.

milestones.name: Gaza (Philistia)
milestones.narrative: Samson pulls down the pillars of Dagon's temple in final triumphant sacrifice.

name: Ruth
summary: A story of covenant loyalty (hesed) during the dark era of the Judges; Ruth's redemption in Bethlehem leads to King David's genealogy.

milestones.name: Plains of Moab
milestones.narrative: Ruth vows to Naomi: Where you go I will go; your people shall be my people, and your God my God.

milestones.name: Barley Fields of Bethlehem
milestones.narrative: Ruth gleans in Boaz's fields; Boaz acts as kinsman-redeemer to marry Ruth.

name: 1 Samuel
region: Shiloh, Gibeah, Valley of Elah & En-Gedi
summary: Transition from judges to monarchy: call of Samuel, tragic coronation of Saul, David's victory over Goliath, and David fleeing Saul in the wilderness.

milestones.name: Shiloh
milestones.narrative: Hannah's answered prayer; young Samuel hears God's voice in the night.

milestones.name: Valley of Elah
milestones.narrative: Young David defeats the 9-foot giant Goliath with sling and smooth stones.

milestones.name: En-Gedi Caves
milestones.narrative: David spares Saul's life in the crags of the wild goats.

milestones.name: Mount Gilboa
milestones.narrative: Saul and Jonathan die in battle against the Philistines.

name: 2 Samuel
summary: David anointed king over Judah in Hebron and united Israel in Jerusalem; the Davidic Covenant; David's fall and repentance; Absalom's revolt.

milestones.name: Hebron
milestones.narrative: David reigns seven years over Judah before the tribes unite.

milestones.name: Jerusalem (Zion)
milestones.narrative: Jebusite fortress conquered; Ark of the Covenant brought up with dancing.

milestones.name: Mount of Olives & Jordan
milestones.narrative: David weeps as he flees Jerusalem during Absalom's rebellion; later restored.

name: 1 Kings
summary: Solomon builds the glorious Temple; kingdom divides into Judah and Israel; Elijah challenges Baal prophets on Mount Carmel.

milestones.name: Temple Mount (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: Solomon dedicates the Temple; glory of the Lord fills the house with fire.

milestones.name: Mount Carmel
milestones.narrative: Elijah challenges 450 prophets of Baal; fire falls from heaven consuming the drenched altar.

milestones.name: Mount Horeb (Sinai)
milestones.narrative: God reveals Himself to Elijah not in the wind, earthquake, or fire, but in a still small voice.

name: 2 Kings
summary: Elijah translated in a fiery whirlwind; Elisha's double portion miracles; fall of Northern Israel to Assyria (722 BC); fall of Jerusalem to Babylon (586 BC).

milestones.name: Jordan River (Near Jericho)
milestones.narrative: Elijah taken to heaven in chariot of fire; Elisha receives mantle.

milestones.name: Samaria
milestones.narrative: Northern Kingdom falls to Sargon II of Assyria; ten tribes deported.

milestones.name: Jerusalem (Hezekiah's Tunnel)
milestones.narrative: Angel of the Lord strikes 185,000 Assyrian soldiers; city delivered.

name: 1 Chronicles
summary: Post-exilic retelling of Israel's royal lineage and David's preparations for the temple worship, Levites, and singers.

milestones.name: Threshing Floor of Ornan
milestones.narrative: David buys the threshing floor where the angel of the Lord stopped; site of future altar.

name: 2 Chronicles
summary: History of the Temple and southern kingdom kings; revivals under Jehoshaphat, Hezekiah, and Josiah; decree of Cyrus of Persia.

milestones.name: Wilderness of Tekoa
milestones.narrative: Jehoshaphat appoints singers before the army; enemies defeat themselves as they praise.

milestones.name: Susa & Babylon
milestones.narrative: Cyrus decrees Jewish return to Jerusalem to rebuild the house of God.

name: Ezra
summary: Remnant returns under Zerubbabel to rebuild the second Temple, followed by Ezra's return to teach the Law and reform the people.

milestones.name: Temple Foundation (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: Old priests weep while young people shout for joy as second Temple foundation laid.

name: Nehemiah
summary: Cupbearer to the Persian king returns to Jerusalem and rebuilds the shattered stone walls in 52 days amid fierce opposition.

milestones.name: Walls of Jerusalem
milestones.narrative: Builders work with a trowel in one hand and a weapon in the other; walls completed in 52 days.

milestones.name: Water Gate (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: Ezra reads the Book of the Law from dawn till noon; people weep and celebrate the Joy of the Lord.

name: Esther
summary: God's providential protection of the Jewish people from genocide in the Persian capital through Queen Esther and Mordecai.

milestones.name: Royal Palace of Susa
milestones.narrative: Esther approaches the throne uninvited: If I perish, I perish; golden scepter held out.

name: Job
summary: The mystery of righteous suffering, divine sovereignty, and redemption; God answers Job out of the whirlwind.

milestones.name: Land of Uz
milestones.narrative: Job declares: I know that my Redeemer lives, and that He shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.

name: Psalms
summary: The inspired hymnal and prayer book of Israel expressing worship, repentance, messianic prophecy, and thanksgiving.

milestones.name: Mount Zion & Temple Sanctuary
milestones.narrative: Psalm 23: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want. He maketh me to lie down in green pastures.

name: Proverbs
summary: Practical moral aphorisms, divine wisdom for righteous living, and the praise of the virtuous Proverbs 31 woman.

milestones.name: Gates of Jerusalem
milestones.narrative: Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding (Prov 3:5).

name: Ecclesiastes
summary: Exploration of the vanity of earthly pursuits apart from God, concluding with the call to fear God and keep His commandments.

milestones.name: Gardens of Solomon (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under heaven (Eccl 3:1).

name: Song of Solomon
summary: A lyrical celebration of marital love, spiritual passion, and Christ's intimate devotion to His bride.

milestones.name: Vineyards of En-Gedi
milestones.narrative: My beloved is unto me as a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of En-gedi.

name: Isaiah
summary: The Fifth Gospel: glorious vision of the Lord high and lifted up, prophecies of the Virgin Birth, the Suffering Servant (Isa 53), and New Creation.

milestones.name: Temple Sanctuary (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: In the year King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord seated on a throne, high and lifted up, and His train filled the temple.

milestones.name: Gihon Conduit
milestones.narrative: Sign of Immanuel given: Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

name: Jeremiah
summary: The weeping prophet's 40-year ministry warning of the Babylonian invasion, promise of the New Covenant written on hearts, and potter's house.

milestones.name: Anathoth (Benjamin)
milestones.narrative: God calls young Jeremiah: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you.

milestones.name: Potter's House (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: The clay reworked in the potter's hand; sovereign grace over nations.

milestones.name: Dungeon Cistern of Malchiah
milestones.narrative: Jeremiah lowered into the deep mud; rescued by Ebed-Melech the Ethiopian.

name: Lamentations
summary: Five acrostic funeral poems weeping over the devastation of Jerusalem, resting in the unshakable truth: Great is Thy Faithfulness.

milestones.name: Ruined Temple Mount
milestones.narrative: The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; His mercies are new every morning: great is Thy faithfulness.

name: Ezekiel
summary: Vision of God's fiery throne chariot in Babylon, departure and return of the Glory, valley of dry bones reviving, and the millennial temple.

milestones.name: River Chebar (Nippur Canal)
milestones.narrative: Ezekiel sees the heavens opened and visions of God with four living creatures and wheels of fire.

milestones.name: Valley of Dry Bones
milestones.narrative: Prophesy to the breath: bone comes to bone, sinews attach, and an exceedingly great army stands!

name: Daniel
summary: Faithfulness in exile, dream of four successive world empires, fourth man in the fiery furnace, lions' den, and end-times apocalyptic visions.

milestones.name: Plain of Dura (Babylon)
milestones.narrative: Three Hebrew youths thrown into seven-times heated furnace; fourth man walking in the fire like the Son of God.

milestones.name: Royal Palace of Babylon
milestones.narrative: Mysterious hand writes on plaster: MENE, MENE, TEKEL, UPHARSIN; Babylon falls that night.

milestones.name: Den of Lions (Babylon)
milestones.narrative: Daniel kept safe overnight: My God sent His angel and shut the lions' mouths.

name: Hosea
summary: Prophetic drama of marriage to unfaithful Gomer, portraying God's unquenchable covenant love for backsliding Israel.

milestones.name: Samaria
milestones.narrative: Hosea buys Gomer back from the slave block: I will betroth you to Me forever in righteousness and love.

name: Joel
summary: Locust plague warning of the Day of the Lord, call to solemn assembly, and prophecy of the Holy Spirit poured out on all flesh.

milestones.name: Valley of Jehoshaphat
milestones.narrative: I will pour out My Spirit upon all flesh; your sons and your daughters shall prophesy.

name: Amos
summary: Shepherd from Tekoa denounces social oppression and empty religion in Israel: Let justice roll down like waters.

milestones.name: Bethel Sanctuary
milestones.narrative: Amos confronts corrupt priest Amaziah: The Lord took me as I followed the flock, and said, Go, prophesy.

name: Obadiah
summary: Divine judgment on haughty Edom for gloating over Jerusalem's destruction; deliverance on Mount Zion.

milestones.name: Sela / Petra (Edom)
milestones.narrative: Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle, and though thou set thy nest among the stars, thence will I bring thee down.

name: Jonah
summary: Reluctant prophet flees to Tarshish, swallowed by a great fish, preaches in brutal Nineveh, and witnesses greatest city revival.

milestones.name: Port of Joppa (Tel Aviv)
milestones.narrative: Jonah boards ship fleeing to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.

milestones.name: Nineveh (Modern Mosul, Iraq)
milestones.narrative: Entire city of 120,000 puts on sackcloth and ashes; God relents from judgment.

name: Micah
summary: Preaches against injustice and announces the exact birthplace of the coming eternal Ruler in Bethlehem Ephrathah.

milestones.name: Bethlehem Ephrathah
milestones.narrative: But thou, Bethlehem Ephratah... out of thee shall He come forth unto Me that is to be Ruler in Israel.

name: Nahum
summary: Proclaims the irreversible destruction of cruel Nineveh by flood and fire, avenging God's scattered people.

milestones.name: Tigris River Gates (Nineveh)
milestones.narrative: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

name: Habakkuk
summary: A prophet's honest dialogue with God about evil and judgment, culminating in the triumphant statement: The just shall live by faith.

milestones.name: Prophetic Watchtower
milestones.narrative: I will stand upon my watch... Though the fig tree shall not blossom... yet I will rejoice in the Lord!

name: Zephaniah
summary: The purifying fire of the Day of the Lord and God's joyful restoration of a humble remnant: The Lord will rejoice over you with singing.

milestones.name: Moriah / Zion
milestones.narrative: The Lord thy God in the midst of thee is mighty; He will save, He will rejoice over thee with joy.

name: Haggai
summary: Exhortation to stop neglecting the Lord's house and rebuild the second Temple: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than the former.

milestones.name: Second Temple Foundation
milestones.narrative: Consider your ways... Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it.

name: Zechariah
summary: Night visions, Messianic prophecies of the King riding on a donkey, pierced for 30 pieces of silver, and feet standing on Mount of Olives.

milestones.name: Mount of Olives
milestones.narrative: His feet shall stand in that day upon the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east.

name: Malachi
summary: Final Old Testament voice addressing corrupt priests, broken covenants, tithing, and the promised forerunner Elijah before the Sun of Righteousness.

milestones.name: Temple Storehouse
milestones.narrative: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse... and prove Me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts.

name: Matthew
summary: Gospel of the Kingdom: Jesus presented as Davidic King, Sermon on the Mount, Kingdom Parables, Olivet Discourse, and Great Commission.

milestones.name: Mount of Beatitudes
milestones.narrative: Blessed are the poor in spirit: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. You are the light of the world.

milestones.name: Capernaum (Galilee Headquarters)
milestones.narrative: Centurion's servant healed; Peter's mother-in-law healed; paralytic let down through the roof.

milestones.name: Caesarea Philippi
milestones.narrative: Peter confesses: Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God. Upon this rock I will build My church.

milestones.name: Golgotha & Garden Tomb
milestones.narrative: Jesus crucified, resurrected on the third day; gives the Great Commission to make disciples of all nations.

name: Mark
summary: Fast-moving Gospel of immediate divine power and servanthood: For even the Son of man came not to be ministered unto, but to minister.

milestones.name: Sea of Galilee Storm
milestones.narrative: Jesus rebukes the tempest: Peace, be still! The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

milestones.name: Gerasenes / Gadara
milestones.narrative: Demoniac with Legion freed; sits clothed and in his right mind at Jesus' feet.

name: Luke
summary: Historical account of compassion for the outcast, parables of grace (Prodigal Son), Zacchaeus in Jericho, and Road to Emmaus revelation.

milestones.name: Nazareth Synagogue
milestones.narrative: The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me, because He hath anointed Me to preach the gospel to the poor.

milestones.name: Jericho Sycamore Tree
milestones.narrative: Zacchaeus comes down: Today is salvation come to this house... The Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

milestones.name: Road to Emmaus
milestones.narrative: Risen Christ opens the scriptures; disciples' hearts burn within them as He breaks bread.

name: John
summary: The divine Son of God: Seven Great Signs and Seven I AM declarations: I am the resurrection, and the life.

milestones.name: Cana of Galilee
milestones.narrative: First miracle: water turned into finest wine at wedding celebration.

milestones.name: Jacob's Well (Sychar)
milestones.narrative: Jesus offers Living Water: God is a Spirit, and they that worship Him must worship in spirit and truth.

milestones.name: Pool of Bethesda
milestones.narrative: Man lame for 38 years takes up his bed and walks at Jesus' command.

milestones.name: Bethany (Tomb of Lazarus)
milestones.narrative: Jesus calls: Lazarus, come forth! The dead man walks out unbound.

name: Acts
region: Jerusalem, Antioch, Asia Minor, Greece & Rome
summary: Outpouring of the Holy Spirit on Pentecost and explosion of the Gospel across the Roman Empire from Jerusalem to Rome.

milestones.name: Upper Room (Jerusalem)
milestones.narrative: Day of Pentecost: Sound of a rushing mighty wind, cloven tongues of fire, 3,000 saved.

milestones.name: Damascus Road
milestones.narrative: Blinding light from heaven knocks Saul down: Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou Me?

milestones.name: Antioch on the Orontes
milestones.narrative: Disciples first called Christians; missionary staging center for Barnabas and Paul.

milestones.name: Philippi (Europe)
milestones.narrative: Midnight praise in prison causes great earthquake; jailer and household saved.

milestones.name: Mars Hill / Areopagus (Athens)
milestones.narrative: Paul preaches the Unknown God to Greek philosophers: In Him we live, and move, and have our being.

milestones.name: Rome
milestones.narrative: Paul preaches unhindered under house arrest, testifying of Christ to Caesar's household.

name: Romans
summary: The masterpiece of salvation: justification by faith alone, the righteousness of God, Romans 8 victory, and living sacrifice.

milestones.name: Imperial Rome
milestones.narrative: I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth.

name: 1 Corinthians
summary: Correcting divisions, immorality, and worship chaos; the Love Chapter (1 Cor 13) and resurrection defense (1 Cor 15).

milestones.name: Ancient Corinth
milestones.narrative: Love is patient, love is kind... And now abide faith, hope, love, these three; but the greatest of these is love.

name: 2 Corinthians
summary: Paul's apostolic heart: treasure in earthen vessels, the ministry of reconciliation, and divine grace perfected in weakness.

milestones.name: Bema Seat of Corinth
milestones.narrative: My grace is sufficient for thee: for My strength is made perfect in weakness.

name: Galatians
region: Antioch to Southern Galatia (Pisidian Antioch, Iconium, Lystra, Derbe)
summary: The Magna Carta of Christian Liberty: defense of pure grace over circumcision/legalism; the fruit of the Spirit.

milestones.name: Iconium & Lystra
milestones.narrative: I am crucified with Christ: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Christ liveth in me.

name: Ephesians
summary: The mystery of the Body of Christ, seated in heavenly places, grace through faith, and putting on the Whole Armor of God.

milestones.name: Great Theater of Ephesus
milestones.narrative: For by grace are ye saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God. Put on the whole armor of God!

name: Philippians
summary: The Epistle of Joy: the mind of Christ (Phil 2 kenosis), pressing toward the mark, and I can do all things through Christ.

milestones.name: Gangites River (Philippi)
milestones.narrative: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice! I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

name: Colossians
summary: The cosmic preeminence of Jesus Christ over all creation, invisible powers, and philosophical deceit: Christ in you, the hope of glory.

milestones.name: Ancient Colossae
milestones.narrative: For by Him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible... He is before all things.

name: 1 Thessalonians
summary: Holy living and the glorious return of Jesus Christ: The Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a shout.

milestones.name: Thessalonica Agora
milestones.narrative: For the Lord Himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel... and so shall we ever be with the Lord.

name: 2 Thessalonians
summary: Clarification on the Day of the Lord, exposing the man of lawlessness, and exhortation to steadfast daily work.

milestones.name: Thessalonica Port
milestones.narrative: Now the Lord of peace Himself give you peace always by all means. The Lord be with you all.

name: 1 Timothy
summary: Pastoral handbook on sound doctrine, elder/deacon qualifications, order in church gatherings, and fighting the good fight of faith.

milestones.name: Ephesus Assembly
milestones.narrative: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called.

name: 2 Timothy
summary: Paul's moving final letter before execution under Nero: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.

milestones.name: Mamertine Prison (Rome)
milestones.narrative: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind. Preach the word!

name: Titus
summary: Establishing healthy churches on the rugged island of Crete, appointing elders, and teaching doctrine that promotes good works.

milestones.name: Gortyn / Crete
milestones.narrative: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ.

name: Philemon
summary: A personal appeal for reconciliation: receiving runaway slave Onesimus not as a bondservant, but as a beloved brother in the Lord.

milestones.name: House Church of Philemon
milestones.narrative: Receive him as myself. If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account.

name: Hebrews
summary: The superiority of Jesus Christ over angels, Moses, and the Levitical priesthood; the Hall of Faith (Hebrews 11) and looking unto Jesus.

milestones.name: Zion / Heavenly Jerusalem
milestones.narrative: Looking unto Jesus the author and finisher of our faith... Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

name: James
region: Jerusalem to Twelve Tribes in Dispersion
summary: Practical faith in action: enduring trials, taming the tongue, prayer of faith, and faith without works is dead.

milestones.name: Early Church of Jerusalem
milestones.narrative: Count it all joy when you fall into divers temptations... Be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only.

name: 1 Peter
region: Rome (Babylon) to Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia & Bithynia
summary: Living hope amid fiery trials: a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a holy nation; casting all your care upon Him.

milestones.name: Provinces of Asia Minor
milestones.narrative: Ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people... to show forth His praises.

name: 2 Peter
summary: Growing in grace and knowledge, divine power for life and godliness, warning against false teachers, and the new heavens and new earth.

milestones.name: Catacombs of Rome
milestones.narrative: Grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To Him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

name: 1 John
summary: Fellowship with God who is Light and Love: walking in the light, loving the brethren, and overcoming the world through faith.

milestones.name: Basilica of Saint John (Ephesus)
milestones.narrative: God is love; and he that dwelleth in love dwelleth in God, and God in him. Greater is He that is in you than he that is in the world.

name: 2 John
keyCharacters: The Elect Lady and her children
summary: Walking in truth and Christian love while guarding against deceivers who deny Christ came in the flesh.

milestones.name: House Church in Asia
milestones.narrative: And this is love, that we walk after His commandments.

name: 3 John
summary: Commending Gaius for hospitality to traveling missionaries and rebuking prideful, gossiping Diotrephes.

milestones.name: Gathering of Gaius
milestones.narrative: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

name: Jude
summary: Urgent summons to contend earnestly for the faith once delivered to the saints; glorious doxology to Him who is able to keep you from falling.

milestones.name: Holy Assembly of Zion
milestones.narrative: Now unto Him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of His glory with exceeding joy!

name: Revelation
region: Isle of Patmos & Seven Churches of Asia Minor
summary: The Revelation of Jesus Christ: glorious vision of Christ in majesty, letters to the seven churches, heavenly throne room worship, victory over Satan, and the descent of the New Jerusalem.

milestones.name: Cave of the Apocalypse (Isle of Patmos)
milestones.narrative: John exiled on Patmos: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet: I am Alpha and Omega!

milestones.name: Seven Churches of Asia Minor (Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, Laodicea)
milestones.narrative: Letters to the seven lampstands: To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life.

milestones.name: Heavenly Throne Room
milestones.narrative: Twenty-four elders cast their crowns before the throne: Worthy is the Lamb that was slain!

milestones.name: The New Jerusalem
milestones.narrative: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth... God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying!
